parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific bug but may introduce regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The change removes the check for `hasattr(obj.model, item)`, which may break other valid use cases where the attribute exists on the model but is not a field.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify the correctness of the changes in various scenarios.
The code structure could be improved for better readability, such as adding comments to explain the logic flow.
